task.title: EACQ-FV EV-2 Capsule Effectiveness Evidence Reconciliation
task.objective: Reconcile three governed capsule-effectiveness observations into the strongest bounded non-causal verdict supported by cited evidence.
nonGoals: Do not modify code, schema, checker, test, roadmap, baseline, work-order, session, registry, or external-folder owners.
Do not invent latency, tokens, difficulty scores, matched controls, or causal estimates.
Do not reopen UAA or make provider/model superiority claims.
Do not stage, commit, push, publish, deploy, call providers, or use credentials.

gateA.name: SOURCE_OWNER_OVERLAP
requiredEvidence: Verify all five pinned SHA-256 values before writing.
Confirm the roadmap owns comparison criteria and the three completion reviews own their observations.
Confirm no existing EV-2 aggregate owns this reconciliation.
Separate task-difficulty and authority-envelope differences from outcome observations.

gateB.name: DESIGN_CODE_TEST
requiredEvidence: Create only the named assessment and worker return.
Cite every comparison cell or mark it NOT_AVAILABLE_WITH_REASON.
Choose exactly one allowed non-causal verdict by the work-order decision contract.
Run pre-implementation, worker-return fast, structural, diff, staging, and status checks.

mustPreserve: Preserve each source artifact's bounded verdict and disclosed repairs.
Keep observed facts separate from adjusted interpretation and inference.
Keep missing latency, token, quota, and matched-control evidence explicit.
Keep UAA, runtime, provider, public, checker, and implementation lanes parked.
forbiddenTransitions: Do not turn promising association into a causal uplift claim.
Do not assign numeric values to unavailable measurements.
Do not compare provider or model identity.
Do not stage or commit worker changes.

freshness.anchor: final unstaged two-path worker diff against execution base

negativeCases: Any uncited metric or invented unavailable value fails.
Any causal, provider-superiority, UAA, runtime, or public claim fails.
Any changed path outside the exact assessment/return manifest fails.
Any verdict outside the four allowed tokens fails.
deterministicChecks: All five SHA-256 pins match before writing.
Every comparison cell has a citation or NOT_AVAILABLE_WITH_REASON.
Exactly one allowed verdict is selected.
